purpose: Completing a reconstruction. The model saw a crop of the storefront banner photograph, which shows thirteen distinct capitals, and was asked for the thirteen capitals it does not show, plus an ampersand and a question mark. Every glyph here is inferred, never observed.

reference.note: The evidence region, enlarged two times. It is the only style reference the model was given.

outputs.observed: All fifteen glyphs are the requested characters, heavy and even. They are wider than the banner's condensed letters: the model matched the weight and missed the width.
outputs.costNote: The provider lists 0.01 dollars per unit and does not report units per request through this tool.
